title: Material Blend 4-Mix Trio #07 (가로 띠·물결 / 동심원·물결 / 대각 띠·물결 | 코이비늘+이레즈미+드래곤비늘+UV네온 / 코이비늘+이레즈미+흑요암금+금박 / 코이비늘+스테인드글라스+금박+공작눈무늬)

Her figure is divided into 4 horizontal bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 22% of the way down her figure from the top, about 58% of the way down her figure from the top and about 79% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the band between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries dragon scales (large thick armor-plate scales, each one substantial and sharply faceted), BLAZING METALLIC GOLD scale formations, VIVID AMBER scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 4 is everything below the last transition zone: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but geyser plasma eruption formations in ELECTRIC GOLD and ORANGE glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle.
